title: Surreal Alien Temple
description: A surreal landscape features a glowing orange and black volcanic entity with multiple eyes and dripping lava-like substance in the foreground. Behind it stands a large Mesoamerican-style stepped pyramid under a dramatic sky with two glowing celestial bodies, surrounded by clusters of translucent blue and purple orbs.
prompt: Surreal alien landscape at twilight with a massive glowing volcanic creature covered in eyes and dripping orange lava in the foreground. A large ancient stepped pyramid temple sits in the background under a colorful sky containing two large glowing celestial orbs. Clusters of translucent blue and purple bubble-like orbs float throughout the scene with dripping colorful liquid effects.
